title: Start University Life
title_vi: Bắt đầu cuộc sống đại học
summary: Minh's first weeks at UFLS, one proverb at a time.
description: Minh is applying to UFLS, completing his enrollment, finding the campus, renting a room and paying his first tuition bill. Each step asks for the proverb that fits the situation; the choice decides how much he loses along the way.
